description: Labelled "What changed" cards for lib/intelligence/changes.mjs. Each row: a followed story (cluster with one seen article and one candidate new article) and the reader snapshot taken 3 h before NOW=1793300000000. expectChange = a reader following the story would want a card (a concrete new development: decision, event, ruling, data release, casualty count, market move). false = retelling/dup of seen coverage, explainer, opinion, preview, reaction roundup, speculation, or a word that merely looks like a trigger. kind material-late-indexed: published before the reader last looked but first indexed after (firstSeenAt). immaterial-stale: a 40 h old article absorbed into the cluster later. holdout:true rows were written after the first tuning pass and measured before any change for them.
